channel.title: Wire — AI
channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: The Open-Sourcing of DeepSeek Harness Opens the Door to Modular, Unbundled AI Agent Infrastructure
item.description: DeepSeek has released a developer preview of DeepSeek Harness (dsh), an open-source execution runtime for building autonomous AI agents. The software features a micro-kernel architecture with modular plugins for various functional units. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: If this is true, the hyperscalers are toast
item.description: The future of AI is not large language models (LLM), but small language models (SLM). Comments (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Whatsapp Tests on Device ML for Scam Detection with Privacy Preserving Analytics
item.description: WhatsApp is testing Scam Alert in limited beta, using on device machine learning to detect potential scam messages from non contacts. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Why Fetch When You Can Sync? Building Local-First Apps on a Sync Engine Architecture
item.description: James Arthur shares why sync is the next frontier in frontend architecture. He explains how extending reactivity to the server with Electric and TanStack DB replaces imperative fetching with declarative data bindings. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: LilScript makes js libraries 5-15% smaller
item.description: LilScript is a typed, compression-first language that compiles into js and sometimes into exec(will be more stable in future). (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: How Code in the Age of Artificial Intelligence Becomes Write-Only and Disposable
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) makes all code write-only,. It’s too dense to read, and tests define the behaviour and become the documentation. Code is also disposable; it becomes easier to rewrite than to debug. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Don't Paste the AI, please
item.description: If someone asks you a question, paste your answer — not the chatbot's. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: InfoQ Opens Enrollment for New AI-Assisted Engineering Online Certification Program
